title: herdr-ticks mission-control plugin
description: Layer 3. A herdr plugin (herdr-plugin.toml) making runs visible and steerable: board pane (live epic dashboard - waves, tick status, worker states - driven by plugin event hooks + tk state), metadata painting via workspace/pane report_metadata (titles like '42i - implement - wave 2/3', TTL token badges for tests/diff size), notification.show with distinct sounds for wave-complete vs worker-blocked, plugin actions (retry tick, open worktree, merge wave, escalate model), link handlers making tick IDs clickable. Distribution: herdr plugin install pengelbrecht/ticks/<subdir>. Rough deliverables: plugin manifest + board TUI + hook scripts + actions + install docs.
